title: No School Friday
can_do: 把学校或外面听来的消息完整转述给家人，并回答追问。

conversation_move.label: report heard news to the family

trigger: Child comes home with real news from Teacher, and Mom has not heard it yet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Good! Teacher says there's no school on Friday.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: She says the teachers have a big meeting.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: So Friday is a family day. What should we do?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: She also says to bring our rain boots tomorrow.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Rain boots? Is it a water-play day?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, for the leaf hunt in the garden!

replay_cards.title: The class plant
replay_cards.setting: School gets a new class plant by the window.
replay_cards.change: Mom has not heard about it yet.
replay_cards.challenge: Child reports what Teacher says about watering days and where the plant sits, and answers Mom's follow-up questions.

replay_cards.title: The shoe shop
replay_cards.setting: Mom comes home from shopping without new shoes.
replay_cards.change: The shop had none in her size.
replay_cards.challenge: Child reports what happened and what Mom bought instead, then answers Dad's questions about it at dinner.

parent_support: 放学后先问“学校有什么新消息”，把报道的机会留给孩子。
孩子转述时故意追问一两个细节：“老师还说什么了？”
把“老师说了什么”当正经新闻听，认真回应，孩子会更愿意当小记者。
